payload.restatement: Adopt the rule share:0.2: act on the 20% highest-scored rows, 725 of the 3,617 development rows in the out-of-fold predictions. There the logistic model's selection had precision 25.2% against 11.5% for the baseline, and recall 43.9%. These predictions were used to choose the rule, so these figures are development evidence and optimistic.
